facts.text: VizdoomScenarioEnv is defined as a subclass of VizdoomEnv
VizdoomBasic-v1 is registered with scenario_config_file basic.cfg and max_buttons_pressed 1
The basic scenario declares three binary buttons: MOVE_LEFT, MOVE_RIGHT and ATTACK
With max_buttons_pressed above zero the binary action space is Discrete(len(button_map)), where button_map holds the button combinations whose pressed count is at most max_buttons_pressed
The wrapper forces the screen format to RGB24 when the config selects neither RGB24 nor GRAY8, and records the channel count: 3 unless the format is GRAY8
The screen observation space is a uint8 Box of [screen height, screen width, channels]
The basic scenario renders at RES_320X240
The observation dictionary always carries the screen and carries depth, labels, automap, audio, notifications and gamevariables only when they are enabled
The game variables are a float32 array with one element per available game variable
The only game variable enabled by the basic scenario is AMMO2
step returns terminated from the game's episode-finished flag and truncated from its episode-timeout flag when treat_episode_timeout_as_truncation is true
On a terminal step there is no game state and the wrapper returns a zero observation instead
The basic scenario sets the living reward to -1
The basic scenario finishes an episode after an episode_timeout of 300 tics
The basic scenario starts an episode after episode_start_time 14 tics
A reset seeds DoomGame with an unsigned 32-bit integer drawn from Gymnasium's generator
The default ViZDoom tic rate is 35 tics per second and the default frame time is 1/35 s
The default frame_skip is 1, so one step advances one frame

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the fake's start state and the dynamics are a fixed counter, so one seed and one action sequence repeat the fake's trajectory; upstream seeds DoomGame from Gymnasium's generator and this fake uses Python's random.Random, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: no Doom dynamics: no map, monster, hit detection, damage, weapon, movement physics or death model. The fake is an analytic stand-in (F0) whose actions only move a marker and decrement ammo, and terminated is always false

the fake observation is smaller than the device's: an 8 x 8 x 3 screen and a one-element gamevariables array, where the real screen is 240 x 320 x 3 (basic.cfg:14) and AMMO2 is one game variable (basic.cfg:38)
the 14-tic episode_start_time (basic.cfg:24) and ViZDoom's per-tic living-reward accounting are simplified: the fake pays one living reward per step and truncates after 300 steps (basic.cfg:27)
no rendering is implemented and no snapshot or restore is offered; the upstream environment exposes no get_state/set_state either
the fake was never compared with upstream ViZDoom: the compiled engine extension and gymnasium were not importable where the gate ran, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation is frozen: after an e-stop the runtime latch rejects every step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears it, and the last observation stays readable
